cohort: 530 women who underwent caesarean section in 5 public hospitals in Thakurgaon District, Bangladesh
finding: Non-medical factors, such as pressure from patients and financial incentives for providers, significantly influence the decision to perform both elective and emergency caesarean sections in public hospitals in Bangladesh.
mod_finding: The study found that 16% of caesarean sections were performed in cases where alternative forms of care might have been more appropriate, suggesting overuse of caesarean section as a mode of delivery.
